desc: rows is a table whose rows may have different numbers of cells. The width of column j is the length of the longest cell at position j over all rows that have such a cell. Render each row from its own cells only (a row never gets extra cells): pad each cell on the right with spaces to its column's width, join the padded cells with " | ", then remove every trailing space from the end of the line (leading spaces stay). A row with no cells renders as "". Return one line per row, in order.
